meaning: sample.bin bytes at file offset 0x00 are 01 D8 (verified on this VM with od -A x -t x1z; sha256 d5022462…850 re-verified)

01 D8 = ADD EAX, EBX (x86-32): EAX <- (EAX_old + EBX) mod 2^32 per \addmod{x}{y}{2^{32}}; CF=carry-out bit31, PF=even parity of result[7:0], AF=carry-out bit3, ZF=(result==0), SF=result[31], OF=carry31 XOR carry32 (standard Intel ADD semantics). This is the hypothesis cited by spec.tex and state-machine.md.
01 /r encoding: ModRM D8 = mod 3, reg 011 (EBX, source), r/m 000 (EAX, destination). Destination is the r/m32 operand = EAX; canonical IR %destination = EAX.
JLE 7E 07: rel8 sign-extended to +7; target = 0x401025 + 2 + 7 = 0x40102E (MOV EAX, 0); taken iff ZF=1 OR (SF != OF); no branch target lands mid-instruction.
ADD stores its result in EBX (operand order reversed: EBX <- EBX + EAX)
reason: Violates Intel 01/r encoding (destination is the r/m32 operand = EAX) and the canonical IR constraint %destination = EAX. Rejected against the observed ModRM byte D8.

meaning: CF is forced to 0 after ADD (carry silently discarded with the wraparound)
reason: Violates standard Intel ADD flag semantics: wraparound discards the carry from the STORED result, but CF must still report carry-out of bit 31. Constraint C3.

meaning: PF = parity of the full 32-bit result
reason: Violates Intel PF semantics (parity of result[7:0] only). Counterexample: result = 0x00000100 -> low byte 0x00 has even parity (true PF=1) but full word has 1 bit set (odd parity, predicted PF=0). REVISED hypothesis (PF on r[7:0]) folded into h2 v1. This is the documented wrong->counterexample->revision->rebuild loop turn.
Violates the Intel OF definition (carry31 XOR carry32). Counterexample: EAX=0x7FFFFFFF + EBX=1 -> result 0x80000000, OF=1 (signed overflow), CF=0. Constraint C3.
Violates documented JLE semantics (taken iff ZF=1 OR SF!=OF). Counterexample: wrapped sum = -1 (signed) <= 10 is taken with ZF=0, SF=1, OF=0. Constraint C4.

meaning: CMP EAX, 10 writes the difference back to EAX
reason: Violates documented CMP semantics (flags from EAX-10, result discarded; EAX unchanged). Would corrupt the threshold predicate. Constraint C4.

meaning: Jump rel8 offsets are absolute addresses (7E 07 -> target 0x07)
reason: Target 0x07 lies outside the function and contradicts the stage1 jump-target verification (target 0x40102E, lands on MOV EAX, 0, no mid-instruction landing). Constraint C4.

meaning: MOV EAX, imm32 updates the flags
reason: Violates Intel MOV semantics (flags unchanged). The JLE must test the CMP flags; a flag-clobbering MOV would break the predicate. Constraints C3/C4.
